matchup: Washington Mystics at Las Vegas Aces

supporting_evidence: Las Vegas was projected at 82 and finished at 83, so the Aces side of the total was essentially calibrated.
Washington was projected at 70 and finished at 76, creating six of the seven total points of projection error.
Washington reduced turnovers from 11 in the first half to 6 in the second half.
Washington improved from 1/5 FT in the first half to 7/11 FT in the second half.
Washington scored 28 second-half paint points after 22 in the first half.
Shakira Austin scored 22 second-half points on 9/11 FG after entering halftime at 3/9 FG.
postmortem.lesson: The full-game Under was not an independent edge from the Washington team-total Under. Both depended on Washington remaining suppressed. Once Washington's turnover, free-throw and interior finishing regression materialized, both derivatives failed together. Treat them as one thesis and cap combined exposure.
